post.ref: Bhagat Kabir Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1349
post.meaning: First God made the Light, and all people are his creation. From that one Light the whole world arose. So who is good and who is bad?
post.caption:
ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੧॥

सबसे पहले ईश्वर ने नूर रचा, और सब उसी क़ुदरत के बंदे हैं। एक ही नूर से सारा जग उपजा; फिर कौन भला और कौन बुरा?

First God made the Light, and all people are his creation. From that one Light the whole world arose. So who is good and who is bad?

— Bhagat Kabir, Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1349

reel.meaning: God has no favourites. But whoever draws near in love finds that God was already within.
reel.caption:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्॥

ईश्वर किसी का पक्ष नहीं लेता; पर जो प्रेम से उसकी ओर बढ़ता है, वह उसे अपने भीतर पाता है।

God has no favourites. But whoever draws near in love finds that God was already within.

— Bhagavad Gita, 9.29
